handoff_channel: A remote or cloud-hosted bot that cannot reach 127.0.0.1 on this PC must not attempt to. There are two doors. Read the spec from outbox/grok/ or outbox/agents/; return the cut under grok/ or agents/. See local_studio/handoff-guide.json (or handoff-guide.ko.json, handoff-guide.zh.json, handoff-guide.ja.json): https://github.com/NoLucas/handoff-inbox (main branch).
token_rule: Once LOCAL_STUDIO_TOKEN is configured it is required on GET requests as well as POST requests. Only /health, /api/terminal-contract, /api/bot-guide, /api/bot-entry (GET), and the CLI download stay open without it. Cross-origin requests (a browser Origin header outside http://localhost:3000 / http://127.0.0.1:3000) are rejected regardless of token configuration.

execution_policy.local_render_rule: auto_local may queue and run this bot's local render; approval_required needs recorded human approval.
execution_policy.instagram_rule: Instagram can upload immediately when auto_upload is enabled for the job, or remain queued for direct execution.

review_required: Only for bots that choose approval_required for local rendering.
